cited_evidence: Job 2 input needs preserve demand record identities such as record_id n06-r01 through n06-r08.
Job 2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while source_id is also s01 through s08.
Observed Job 2 priorities all have upstream_rank: 0 despite evidence_sources containing ranks 1 through 8.
assemble_provenance source appends {'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), ...}, replacing demand record_id with source_id.
initial_receipt.explanation: The two-job execution contains a provenance handoff fault. Job 2 receives needs with record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08, but evidence_sources with record_id values s01 through s08. As a result, prioritize cannot match provenance ranks to coverage records and every observed upstream_rank is 0, violating the requirement to preserve upstream provenance order. The supplied upstream source localizes this to assemble_provenance, which writes record_id from source_id instead of preserving the demand record_id.
